items: 【21V Power Cordless Drill with LED】 Sundpey 255 Pieces 21V Power Cordless Drill has a wide range of applications. The cordless drill combo kit can tighten screws and drill holes in plastic, wood, ceramics, and glass. The machine is equipped with built-in LED light and two gears, the 1st gear is 0-350rpm, the 2nd gear is 0-1350rpm, the maximum clamping range of the chuck is 3/8'' (10mm) and 18+1 torque adjustment (Max 34N.m). The hand drill driver weights only 1.5 kg including the battery, and it is easy to operate with one hand.

【2 Replacement Rechargeable Batteries】 This 21Volt power drill cordless has two 2.0Ah rechargeable Lithium-ion batteries, one battery quickly fully charged only 1.5 hours and can be used continuously for about 1 hour. Each battery is small and lightweight, whether you are using it indoors or outdoors, making it easy to carry and replace. When not using batteries, please retain power for the battery, so as to better protect the battery life.

【Multi-functional Accessories Set】 This household and auto repair tool kit combines general basic, practical and essential tool accessories in one package. The toolkit box includes Rip Claw Hammer, Adjustable Wrench, Sharp-nosed Pliers, Tape Measure, Hex Key Wrench Set, Screwdriver, Socket, Twist Drill Sets(1.5mm 2mm 2.5mm 3mm 3.5mm 4mm 4.5mm 5mm 5.5mm 6mm), Wood Drill Bits(5 mm 6 mm 8 mm), Flat Drills(10mm 12mm 16mm 18mm 20mm), Stainless Steel Ruler, Woodworking Pen, Extension Bar, 200mm Flexible Shaft, Expansion Screw sets(134pcs), Rechargeable Electric Drill(rechargeable batteries and charging adapter), etc.

【Portable Storage & Special Present Choice】 All the hand tools and Cordless tool are packed in a unique complete tool box set for storage and portability. Each hand tool fits snugly into its respective place to prevent moving around and scraping. All tools set are neatly stored in a sturdy case to keep tools secure, clean, organized and easy to find. This tool kit set is nice for Mother's Day, Father's Day and it is a nice option as tool present for Dad, Mom, Grandfather, Grandmother, Brothers, boyfriend and lover friends in Newyear, Easter Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, Birthday, Anniversaries Days.

【100% Customer Service】 Sundpey tool kit with drill offers a 12-month product service and is committed to providing good quality tool sets and service to all customers. If you have any questions, please tell us in time, we will reply you within 24 hours.
